source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / ASPIRE Project (IFAD-funded) - "Climate Resilient Banana Growing Technique" (ផលិតកម្មដំណាំចេកដែលធន់ទៅនឹងការប្រែប្រួលអាកាសធាតុ), November 2018
text:
Choosing healthy planting material is presented as the starting point for a resilient banana stand. Farmers are advised to select a sword sucker (a narrow-leaved, vigorously growing offshoot) about 30 centimeters tall or more from a healthy mother clump that shows no signs of disease, taking it from a clump grown for less than about 15 months so the sucker is not overly mature.

The sucker should be cut cleanly away from the mother rhizome with a sharp tool, and any offshoots taken from a clump near or adjacent to a diseased plant should be avoided entirely, since disease such as Fusarium wilt and bunchy top virus can be carried in planting material that shows no obvious external symptoms yet.
